Okay, aneutronic fusion means no neutron radiation, so I need to visually contrast that with standard fusion. I'll use Three.js to build a 3D particle simulation where we zoom into a reactor core and watch proton-boron nuclei collide, overcome the Coulomb barrier, and fuse into helium nuclei that jet away as clean alpha particles. I'll make the nuclei glow with custom shaders, use intense chromatic flares for the energy release, and keep the background dark so the charged particle trails really pop against the void.
